children: SANTA BARBARA, Calif., Sept. 10, 2026
-- DRYWORLD Brands Inc. (OTC:

) (the ‘Company’), DRYWORLD, the premium performance sportswear brand known for innovation, quality, and athlete-first design, today announced a landmark partnership with GOAT Farms to become the Official Uniform Supplier and Merchandise Partner of the US Army Bowl, widely recognized as the nation's biggest week in football. See the

covering the journey of Chase Guers, a 6-foot-3, 190-pound four-star wide receiver and defensive back from Blue Mountain High School in Pennsylvania, to becoming the first All-American High School Player selected for the 2026 US Army Bowl x DRYWORLD Uniform Reveal.

The US Army Bowl culminates each December with the nationally televised US Army Bowl Game, broadcast live from AT&T Stadium, home of the Dallas Cowboys, featuring the top 80 high school boys and top 30 high school girls football players in America competing on one stage. The event has become a leading platform for elite football talent, attracting college recruiters, media, and football fans from across the country.

As part of the agreement, DRYWORLD will provide official on-field uniforms, performance apparel, training gear, fan merchandise, and event-specific collections for the prestigious US Army Bowl and its expanding national showcase platform. Additionally, DRYWORLD has introduced the program’s first-ever online merchandise platform, US All-American Bowl, featuring the US All-American Collection, which brings together the nation’s elite young athletes to represent the very best of American football. This collection celebrates the pride, honor, and tradition of being named an All-American. New merchandise drops will be released periodically in the lead up to the Nations Biggest Week in Football.
SUMMER SHOWCASE

In addition to the All-American Game, the partnership includes the rapidly growing National Summer Showcase, which brings together approximately 600 of the nation's top youth football athletes, including:
• Middle School Boys Tackle Football
• High School Boys Tackle Football
• Middle School Girls Flag Football
• High School Girls Flag Football

The Summer Showcase has established itself as one of the most important identification and development events in youth football, providing athletes with opportunities to compete against the best talent in the country while gaining national exposure.
The Nation's Biggest Week in Football
The US Army Bowl has evolved into far more than a single All-American game—it now represents the nation's biggest week in football.

During the week leading up to the nationally televised US Army Bowl Game on Saturday, December 17, Dallas will host an unprecedented gathering of football talent from across the United States. More than 4,000 of the country's top football athletes will converge for a series of elite showcase events, tournaments, combines, and national championship competitions designed to identify and celebrate the next generation of football stars.

The week-long football showcase will feature fiercely competitive tournament play for both Middle School and High School Boys Tackle Football programs, convening many of the nation's most accomplished teams and athletes. These events will deliver unparalleled exposure to college recruiters, scouts, media, and football fans while establishing one of the most competitive youth football environments in the country.

In addition, the event will showcase the explosive growth of girls football through a nationally televised High School Girls Flag Football All-American Game featuring many of the top female athletes in the nation. The game will spotlight the future stars of one of the fastest-growing sports in America and provide a national platform for elite female football talent.

The week culminates with the US Army Bowl All-American Game at AT&T Stadium, where the nation's top 80 high school football players will compete under the lights on one of football's biggest stages. Together, these events create a one-of-a-kind football celebration that unites youth, high school, boys, and girls athletes into a single national showcase unlike anything else in the sport.

"We are incredibly excited to partner with GOAT Farms and the US Army Bowl platform," said DRYWORLD VP OF US Partnerships Craig Pettigrew. "The US Army Bowl represents excellence, opportunity, and the future of football. From the elite athletes competing in the National Summer Showcase to the top 80 tackle and top 30 high school flag players taking the field at AT&T Stadium, this platform embodies everything DRYWORLD stands for. We look forward to delivering elite-caliber uniforms, apparel, and merchandise that reflect the stature of these events and energize the next generation of athletes."

The partnership will introduce custom-designed performance uniforms featuring DRYWORLD's advanced fabric technologies, premium athlete-focused construction, and exclusive event merchandise collections available to players, families, coaches, and fans nationwide.

"Partnering with DRYWORLD is a significant step forward for the US Army Bowl and our entire football ecosystem," said Rich McGuinness, GOAT Farms founder. "DRYWORLD shares our commitment to innovation, performance, and elevating the athlete experience. Together, we are building a best-in-class platform that showcases the nation's top football talent while delivering premium products worthy of the biggest week in football."

The partnership underscores the continued growth of both organizations as they expand opportunities for athletes at every level of the game. Through elite competition, national exposure, and premium performance apparel, DRYWORLD and GOAT Farms aim to further establish the US Army Bowl as the premier destination for football's next generation.
About GOAT Farms

GOAT Farms is a sports and entertainment company focused on developing leading athletic events, athlete development platforms, media properties, and brand partnerships. Through the US Army Bowl and National Summer Showcase, GOAT Farms provides elite athletes with opportunities to compete, develop, and gain national recognition.
ABOUT DRYWORLD:

DRYWORLD is a premium performance sports brand offering innovative, superior-quality apparel, footwear, teamwear, and gear for the athlete in all of us. We build purpose-driven products that give all athletes the edge. Engineered by athletes, proven by science. Visit http://www.dryworldshop.com
